caption: The drawing depicts a standing figure with a crown on its head, dressed in a blue cape adorned with white stars, draped over a pink tunic with a light blue inner garment. The figure's hands are pressed together in front of the chest in a prayerful gesture. Behind the figure is a radiating arrangement of pointed, yellowish-white beams forming a backdrop. The figure stands atop a crescent-shaped, golden-brown base, which is supported by a human face and upper torso, colored in reddish-brown, looking forward. The base rests on a simple, rectangular platform shaded in gray. The background of the image is plain and uncolored. The artist’s signature "MAJEL G. CHAPLIN - TAOS. N.M." appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Guadalupe Wood Santo or Bulto
